about: Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) is an Atlanta-based operator of global exchanges and clearing houses, listed on the NYSE (ICE), owning the New York Stock Exchange, ICE Futures, ICE Data Services and mortgage technology after buying Black Knight. Revenue is around $9 billion. Founded in 2000. Financial infrastructure with strong brand awareness in markets.

wiki.title: Intercontinental Exchange
wiki.what: American exchange and clearing house company
wiki.text: Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. (ICE) is an American multinational financial services company that operates global financial exchanges, including stock exchanges and futures exchanges, as well as clearing houses, and provides technology and services for mortgage loan origination, closing, and servicing.

about: China Molybdenum (CMOC Group) is a Chinese mining company, run from Luoyang, Henan, that mines and produces copper, cobalt, molybdenum, tungsten, niobium and phosphates, with major assets in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Tenke Fungurume and Kisanfu) and Brazil. It is listed in Shanghai and Hong Kong (603993 / 3993), with revenue of over 200 billion yuan. B2B commodity miner with no consumer brand.

wiki.title: CMOC Group Limited
wiki.text: CMOC or CMOC Group Limited, previously known as China Molybdenum Company Limited, is a Chinese mining company and one of the world's largest producers of molybdenum, tungsten, niobium, cobalt, and copper. The company accounts for approximately one-third of global cobalt supply.

about: Gerdau is a Brazilian steel producer based in Sao Paulo, Latin America's leading producer of long steel products. It makes rebar, wire rod, structural shapes and special steels for construction, industry and agriculture, with mills in Brazil, North America (as the largest US long steel maker by volume in some segments), South America and India. Founded in 1901 and listed on the Sao Paulo exchange and NYSE (GGB). B2B with moderate consumer visibility in Brazil.

wiki.title: Gerdau
wiki.text: Gerdau S.A. is the largest producer of long steel in the Americas, and the 33rd largest steelmaker worldwide, with approximately 13 million tons of production in 2023. Gerdau uses mini mills, integrated mills, and direct reduced iron plants; 71% of the steel manufactured by the company is made from recycled scrap. In 2023, 39% of sales were to Brazil and 39% of sales were to North America.

about: Rio Tinto is one of the world's largest mining groups, headquartered in London and listed in London (RIO), Sydney and New York. It produces iron ore, aluminium, copper, lithium (after buying Arcadium in 2025) and minerals, with revenue of over $50 billion and about 55,000 employees. Founded in 1873. A B2B commodities brand with limited consumer recognition, though it is visible in Australian and Canadian business circles.

wiki.title: Rio Tinto (corporation)
wiki.text: Rio Tinto Group is a British–Australian multinational mining company headquartered in London, England, and Melbourne, Australia. It was founded in 1873 when a group of British investors purchased a mine complex on the Río Tinto, in Huelva, Spain, from the Spanish government. It has grown through a long series of mergers and acquisitions and is today a major producer of commodities such as copper, iron ore, aluminium and lithium.

about: Anglo American is a London-based global mining company, listed on the London Stock Exchange (AAL) and in Johannesburg, producing copper, iron ore through Kumba and Minas-Rio, premium crop nutrients, and steelmaking coal, and formerly platinum group metals (spun off as Valterra Platinum in 2025). It historically owned De Beers diamonds, which it has been selling. In 2025 it agreed a merger with Teck Resources. Customers are smelters, steelmakers and industrial buyers. B2B miner with little consumer awareness, although De Beers is a consumer brand.

Tata Steel is one of the world's largest steelmakers, headquartered in Mumbai and part of the Tata Group, listed on the NSE and BSE (TATASTEEL). It produces about 35 million tonnes of steel a year, with operations in India, the UK, the Netherlands and Southeast Asia, and mining interests. Customers include automotive, construction and engineering firms. Funding of about 500M reflects bonds or loans recorded in 2025. Strong B2B and corporate brand, with sponsorship of events like Tata Steel Chess and the Tata Steel Kolkata marathon.

wiki.title: Tata Steel
wiki.text: Tata Steel Limited is an Indian multinational steel company headquartered in Mumbai and is part of the Tata Group. Formerly known as Tata Iron and Steel Company Limited (TISCO), the company was established on 26 August 1907 in Jamshedpur.

about: Teck Resources is a Vancouver-based diversified mining company producing copper, zinc and steelmaking coal, with major mines in Canada, Chile and Peru including Highland Valley Copper, Quebrada Blanca and Red Dog. In 2024 it sold its steelmaking coal business to Glencore, and in 2025 it agreed to merge with Anglo American, creating Anglo Teck. Customers are smelters, steel mills and industrial buyers; annual revenue is around C$10 billion. Listed on the TSX and NYSE (TECK). B2B resource brand with limited consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Teck Resources
wiki.text: Teck Resources Limited is a diversified natural resources company headquartered in Vancouver, British Columbia, that is engaged in mining and mineral development, including coal for the steelmaking industry, copper, zinc, and energy. Secondary products include lead, silver, gold, molybdenum, germanium, indium and cadmium. Teck Resources was formed from the amalgamation of Teck and Cominco in 2001.

about: JSW Steel is one of India's largest steel producers, part of the JSW Group led by Sajjan Jindal, headquartered in Mumbai. It operates integrated plants at Vijayanagar, Dolvi and Salem with a capacity of around 30 million tonnes a year, selling flat and long steel to construction, automotive, appliances and infrastructure customers. Listed on the NSE and BSE (JSWSTEEL), with revenue of about 1.7 trillion rupees. The JSW group sponsors sport, including cricket and Olympic athletes, so it has some brand visibility.

wiki.title: JSW Steel
wiki.text: JSW Steel Limited is an Indian multinational steel company based in Mumbai and is a flagship company of the JSW Group.

about: South Korean steelmaker, one of the world's largest, producing flat and long steel products, stainless steel and specialty alloys, now organised as POSCO Holdings with businesses in steel, batteries and lithium, trading and infrastructure. Founded in 1968 and headquartered in Pohang, it has crude steel capacity of about 40 million tonnes, with plants at Pohang and Gwangyang. Listed in Seoul (005490) and on the NYSE through ADRs. Customers are automakers, shipbuilders and construction firms. Strong brand in Korea, owning the Pohang Steelers football club and sponsoring local sport.

wiki.title: POSCO
wiki.text: POSCO is a South Korean steel manufacturer headquartered in Pohang, South Korea. It had an output of 42,000,000 metric tons of crude steel in 2015, making it the world's Seventh-largest steelmaker by this measure. In 2010, it was the world's largest steel manufacturing company by market value. Also, in 2024, it was named as the world's 233rd-largest corporation by the Fortune Global 500.

about: One of the world's biggest gold mining companies, with mines in Africa, Australia and the Americas, and a corporate base that moved from Johannesburg to London and a listing on the NYSE in 2023. It produces roughly 2.5 to 3 million ounces of gold a year, selling mainly to bullion refiners. Operations include Obuasi in Ghana, Kibali in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and the Sukari mine in Egypt. Heavily B2B with commodity sales, so little consumer awareness, although it is a major mining brand globally.

wiki.title: AngloGold Ashanti
wiki.text: AngloGold Ashanti Limited is a South African gold mining company, with global operations. With a diverse portfolio of cooperation, projects, and exploration activities, AngloGold Ashanti was formed in 2004 by the merger of AngloGold and the Ashanti Goldfields Corporation.

about: Dauch Corporation is the renamed American Axle & Manufacturing, a Detroit-based global Tier 1 automotive supplier of driveline, axle, metal forming and, after acquiring Dowlais Group in 2025, the GKN Automotive driveline and powder metal businesses. Customers are carmakers and truck manufacturers worldwide, with revenue of about $10 billion on the combined basis. Listed on NYSE. B2B supplier with no consumer awareness.
cb_desc: Dauch is a premier global Tier 1 automotive supplier...

about: Houston-headquartered cement, concrete and aggregates producer with Mexican origins, operating in about 50 countries and generating revenue around $16 billion. Listed on the Mexican exchange and the NYSE (CX). B2B construction materials brand, known to builders; limited consumer visibility. CEMEX has roughly 45,000 employees and is among the world's top cement producers. CEMEX employs about 45,000 people and sells cement and ready-mix concrete in Mexico, the US, Europe and other markets, and has a global trading arm.

wiki.title: Cemex
wiki.text: CEMEX, S.A.B. de C.V., known as Cemex, is a Mexican multinational building materials company headquartered in San Pedro, near Monterrey, Nuevo León, Mexico. It manufactures and distributes cement, ready-mix concrete and aggregates in more than 50 countries. In 2020 it was ranked as the 5th largest cement company in the world, at 87.09 million tonnes.

about: Space company founded by Elon Musk in 2002, headquartered at Starbase, Texas, building Falcon rockets, Dragon capsules, Starship and the Starlink satellite internet network, which has millions of subscribers worldwide. Privately held, valued at around $400 billion in late 2025, and combined with xAI in 2026. Very high consumer brand visibility. SpaceX employs more than 13,000 people, launches most of the world's orbital missions, and its Starlink service has millions of subscribers.

wiki.title: SpaceX
wiki.text: Space Exploration Technologies Corp., doing business as SpaceX, is an American conglomerate which is a aerospace manufacturer and provider of space transportation, telecommunications, and artificial intelligence (AI) services, headquartered at the Starbase development site in Starbase, Texas. The company operates three primary segments: Space, which develops and flies the Falcon 9, Falcon Heavy, and Starship launch vehicles, as well as the Dragon spacecraft, and conducts more orbital launches annually than any other launch provider ; Connectivity, which operates the Starlink satellite constellation and satellite-based high-speed broadband int

about: Essen-based German specialty chemicals company, producing additives, amino acids, silica and performance materials for the consumer goods, health, automotive and animal nutrition industries, with revenue near EUR 15 billion. Listed in Frankfurt (EVK). B2B brand with low consumer awareness, though it is a sports sponsor in German football. Evonik employs about 33,000 people and operates in over 100 countries, and its customers include makers of cosmetics, tyres and animal feed.

wiki.title: Evonik Industries
wiki.text: Evonik Industries AG is a publicly listed German chemicals company headquartered in Essen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany. It is the second-largest chemicals company in Germany, and one of the largest specialty chemicals companies in the world. It is predominantly owned by the RAG Foundation and was founded on 12 September 2007 as a result of restructuring of the mining and technology group RAG AG.

about: Pittsburgh-based US paints and coatings maker, founded 1883, supplying architectural, automotive, aerospace and industrial coatings, with brands like Sigma, Glidden and Olympic. Revenue is about $16 billion. Listed on the NYSE (PPG). B2B brand with some consumer paint exposure, and a long-time presence in motorsport coatings. PPG employs about 47,000 people and operates in over 70 countries, and its customers include carmakers, aircraft makers and home builders.

wiki.title: PPG Industries
wiki.what: Global supplier of glass and chemical products
wiki.text: PPG Industries, Inc. is an American supplier of paints, coatings, and specialty materials based in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. It operates in more than 70 countries globally. A member of the Fortune 500, PPG is the second largest coatings company in the world by revenue, behind Sherwin-Williams. It is headquartered in PPG Place, an office and retail complex in downtown Pittsburgh, and is known for its glass facade designed by Postmodern architect Philip Johnson.

about: Celanese is a Texas-based global chemical and specialty materials company, listed on the New York Stock Exchange (CE). It produces acetyl chain products, engineered materials, and polymers sold to manufacturers in automotive, medical, filtration, paints and consumer goods, earning about $10 billion of revenue a year. It acquired DuPont's Mobility and Materials business in 2022. Customers are industrial companies worldwide. B2B, with little consumer brand awareness.

wiki.title: Celanese
wiki.text: Celanese Corporation, formerly known as Hoechst Celanese, is an American technology and specialty materials company headquartered in Irving, Texas. It is a Fortune 500 corporation. The company is the world's leading producer of acetic acid, producing about 1.95 million tonnes per year, representing approximately 20% of global production. Celanese is also the world's largest producer of vinyl acetate monomer (VAM).

about: BHP is the world's largest listed mining company, headquartered in Melbourne, with shares listed in Australia (BHP), London and New York. It produces iron ore, copper, metallurgical coal, potash and nickel, selling commodities to steelmakers and manufacturers worldwide, mainly in China, with revenue of about $50 billion a year. It operates large sites in Australia and the Americas. B2B commodity producer with strong corporate profile, but no consumer product brand.

wiki.title: BHP
wiki.what: Australian multinational mining and metals company
wiki.text: BHP Group Limited, founded as the Broken Hill Proprietary Company, is an Australian multinational mining and metals corporation. BHP was established in August 1885 in Broken Hill and is headquartered in Melbourne, Victoria. The company specialises in mining and selling iron ore, copper and coal.

about: South African chemicals and energy company based in Sandton, producing synthetic fuels from coal and gas, plus chemicals. Operates in South Africa, Mozambique and the US. Listed on JSE and NYSE (SSL). Revenue around ZAR 270 billion. Consumer awareness is moderate in South Africa through its fuel and brand activity.

wiki.title: Sasol
wiki.what: South African integrated energy and chemical company
wiki.text: Sasol Limited, commonly referred to as Sasol, is an integrated energy and chemical company based in Sandton, South Africa.

about: Sasol is a South African integrated energy and chemicals company, headquartered in Johannesburg (Sandton), famed for coal-to-liquids technology, making fuels, chemicals and gas from coal and gas in South Africa and chemicals in the US and Europe. Listed on the JSE (SOL) and the NYSE. Revenue is around 15 billion dollars. Strong brand in South African fuel retail and a well-known sponsor in motorsport and sport.
flags: name read with low OCR confidence: check spelling

wiki.title: Sasol
wiki.what: South African integrated energy and chemical company
wiki.text: Sasol Limited, commonly referred to as Sasol, is an integrated energy and chemical company based in Sandton, South Africa.

about: Amcor is a global packaging company, with primary corporate offices in Zurich and operations run from Australia and the US (Warrendale, Pennsylvania), making flexible and rigid plastic packaging, bottles and containers for food, beverage, healthcare and consumer goods. Formed by the 2019 Amcor-Bemis merger, and it completed a combination with Berry Global in 2025. Listed on the NYSE (AMCR) and ASX. Revenue is about 13-14 billion dollars. B2B, little consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Amcor
wiki.text: Amcor plc is a multinational packaging company founded in Australia that develops and produces flexible packaging, rigid containers, specialty cartons, closures and services for food, beverage, pharmaceutical, medical-device, home and personal-care, and other products.

about: Covestro is a Leverkusen, Germany maker of high-performance polymers, including polycarbonates and polyurethanes, serving the auto, construction, electronics and furniture industries, with revenue of about 14 billion euros. Spun out of Bayer in 2015, it was bought by ADNOC (Abu Dhabi National Oil Company) in 2025 for about 14.7 billion euros and delisted. B2B materials supplier with limited consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Covestro
wiki.text: Covestro AG is a German company producing polyurethane and polycarbonate raw materials. Products include isocyanates and polyols for cellular foams, thermoplastic polyurethane and polycarbonate pellets, as well as polyurethane based additives used in the formulation of coatings and adhesives. It is a Bayer spin-off formed in the fall of 2015 and was formerly called Bayer MaterialScience.

about: Air Liquide is a French multinational and world leader in industrial gases such as oxygen, nitrogen, hydrogen and argon, selling to the steel, chemicals, electronics, food and healthcare industries, and operating home healthcare services. Founded in 1902 and headquartered in Paris, it has over 66,000 employees in about 60 countries and revenue above 27 billion euros. Listed on Euronext Paris (AI). It is a known sponsor in motorsport circles, but is mostly a B2B industrial brand with moderate public awareness.

wiki.title: Air Liquide
wiki.text: Air Liquide S.A. is a French multinational company which supplies industrial gases and services to various industries including medical, chemical and electronic manufacturers. Founded in 1902, Air Liquide is the second largest global supplier of industrial gases by revenues and has operations in over 70 countries.

about: Chemours is a US chemical company spun out of DuPont in 2015, headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware. It makes titanium dioxide pigment (Ti-Pure), fluoroproducts and refrigerants (Opteon, Freon), Teflon-brand materials and Nafion membranes. Customers are makers of paints, plastics, air conditioning, semiconductors and electric vehicles. Listed on the NYSE (CC), with revenue around 6 billion dollars. Teflon is a household name, but the Chemours corporate brand is mainly B2B, and it has faced PFAS litigation.

wiki.title: Chemours
wiki.text: The Chemours Company, headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware, is an American chemical company. It was spun off from DuPont in July 2015. The company's primary products are refrigerants, titanium dioxide pigment, and industrial fluoropolymer resins. The company operates 28 major production facilities in 8 countries and serves approximately 2,400 customers in approximately 110 countries as of 2025.

about: Clariant is a Swiss specialty chemicals company based in Muttenz near Basel, with products for catalysts, adsorbents, additives and care chemicals, sold to makers of plastics, oil and gas, mining, personal care and agriculture. It operates in around 90 countries with revenue near 4 billion Swiss francs and is listed on SIX Swiss Exchange (CLN), with Saudi SABIC a major shareholder. Spun out of Sandoz in 1995. B2B with limited consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Clariant
wiki.text: Clariant AG is a Swiss multinational speciality chemical company, formed in 1995 as a spin-off from Sandoz. Headquartered in Muttenz, Switzerland, the public company encompasses 68 subsidiaries in 36 countries (2023). Major manufacturing sites are located in Europe, North America, South America, China, and India. In 2025, sales from continuing operations were 3.915 billion CHF.

about: Hithium Energy Storage is a Chinese battery maker founded in 2019 and based in Xiamen, Fujian, focused on lithium-ion cells and energy storage systems for utilities, solar and wind developers and commercial users. It produces large-format LFP cells, notably its 300Ah and 1175Ah cells, and sells containerised storage systems worldwide. It has raised significant venture and strategic funding and filed for a Hong Kong listing. B2B supplier with limited public brand awareness.
cb_desc: Hithium Energy Storage is a tech enterprise, specializing i...

about: Air Products and Chemicals is a leading supplier of industrial gases such as oxygen, nitrogen, argon and hydrogen, along with related equipment and services, to refining, chemicals, metals, electronics, food and healthcare customers. It is a major builder of large hydrogen and clean energy projects, including NEOM in Saudi Arabia. Founded in 1940 and headquartered in Allentown, Pennsylvania, with operations in over 50 countries, roughly 23,000 employees and about 12 billion dollars of revenue. Listed on the NYSE (APD). B2B with low consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Air Products
wiki.text: Air Products and Chemicals, Inc. is a U.S.-based international corporation whose principal business is selling gases and chemicals for industrial use. Air Products is headquartered in Trexlertown, Pennsylvania, in the Lehigh Valley region of eastern Pennsylvania.

about: Arkema is a French specialty chemicals and advanced materials group created in 2004 from the spin-off of Total's chemicals arm. It makes high-performance polymers (Kynar, Pebax), adhesives (Bostik), coating solutions, acrylics and intermediates for construction, batteries, packaging, transport and electronics. Headquartered in Colombes/Puteaux near Paris, with about 21,000 employees, sites in around 55 countries and revenue near 9 billion euros. Listed on Euronext Paris (AKE). B2B with low consumer awareness; Bostik adhesives and Pebax sports materials give some indirect visibility.

wiki.title: Arkema
wiki.text: Arkema S.A. is a publicly listed, multi-national manufacturer of specialty materials, headquartered in La Défense, near Paris, France. It has three specialty materials segments ; adhesives, advanced materials and coatings. A further segment covers primary materials.

about: Syensqo is a Belgian advanced materials and specialty chemicals company spun off from Solvay in December 2023 (Solvay retained the commodities side). It makes high-performance polymers, composites, battery materials, aroma and fragrance ingredients and solvents for aerospace, automotive, electronics, energy and consumer goods. Headquartered in Brussels, with about 13,000 employees and sales near 6 billion euros. Listed on Euronext Brussels (SYENS). B2B with limited consumer awareness, although materials appear in aircraft and car components, and it has supported solar flight projects.

wiki.title: Syensqo
wiki.text: Syensqo is a Belgian multinational chemicals and advanced materials company, headquartered in Brussels, Belgium. It was established in December 2023, through the spin-off from Solvay. The current CEO is Mike Radossich, who succeeded Ilham Kadri in January 2026.

about: Orbia is a Mexican-founded global group (formerly Mexichem) with operations across five business groups: Polymer Solutions, Building and Infrastructure (Wavin pipes), Precision Agriculture (Netafim drip irrigation), Connectivity Solutions and Fluor and Energy Materials (Koura refrigerants). It sells to construction, agriculture, telecom and healthcare customers in about 50 countries, with revenue near 7.5 billion dollars. Listed on the Mexican exchange (ORBIA), with a Boston business office. B2B industrial brand, some local awareness via Wavin and Netafim.

wiki.title: Orbia
wiki.text: Orbia is a company providing specialty products and methodologies in the agriculture, building and infrastructure, fluorinated solutions, polymer solutions, and data communications sectors. It was founded in 1953 and has headquarters in Mexico City.

about: Eastman Chemical is a Kingsport, Tennessee specialty materials company, listed on the NYSE (EMN), spun off from Eastman Kodak in 1994. It makes advanced materials, additives, fibers and chemicals, including Tritan copolyester used in consumer products and the Naia fibers, and has molecular recycling operations. Customers are packaging, building, automotive, personal care and consumer goods makers, with revenue of about $9 billion and around 14,000 employees. B2B supplier, with brand recognition through products used in consumer goods.

wiki.title: Eastman Chemical Company
wiki.text: Eastman Chemical Company is an American chemical products manufacturer based in Kingsport, Tennessee. Founded in 1920, it was a subsidiary of Kodak until 1994. The company is an independent global specialty materials company that produces a broad range of advanced materials, chemicals and fibers for everyday purposes. It operates 36 manufacturing sites worldwide and employs approximately 14,000 people. In 2023, Eastman had sales revenue of approximately $9.21 billion.

about: Maire Tecnimont, now operating as Maire, is an Italian engineering and technology group based in Milan, listed on Borsa Italiana (MAIRE). Through NextChem and Tecnimont, it designs and builds plants for fertilisers, polymers, gas processing, hydrogen and chemicals recycling worldwide, working for energy and industrial clients, with revenue of around 5-6 billion euros. B2B engineering contractor with strong industry reputation and no consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Maire Tecnimont
wiki.text: MAIRE is an Italian engineering and contracting company. Formed in 2005 from the merger of Fiat Engineering and Tecnimont, it is publicly traded on the Milan Stock Exchange. Headquartered in Milan, the company provides engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services and technology solutions for the energy, chemicals, and industrial sectors. It operates globally through subsidiaries including Tecnimont, NextChem, and Stamicarbon.

about: Worley is an Australian engineering and professional services group, based in Sydney, delivering design, project management and sustainability services for energy, chemicals and resources customers in around 40 countries. It employs about 50,000 people and has revenue near AUD 12 billion, after acquiring Jacobs' Energy, Chemicals and Resources business in 2019. Listed on the ASX (WOR). B2B engineering brand, with no consumer profile.

wiki.title: Worley (company)
wiki.text: Worley Limited is an Australian engineering and professional services company which provides consulting and project delivery expertise to the energy, chemicals and resources sectors, and complex process industries.

about: Henkel is a German consumer and industrial goods group based in Dusseldorf, with brands such as Persil, Schwarzkopf, Dial, Pritt, Loctite and Technomelt. It operates adhesive technologies, beauty care and laundry and home care divisions in more than 70 countries, employs about 47,000 people and has revenue near EUR 21 billion. It is listed in Frankfurt (HEN3), controlled by the Henkel family. Many household brands are widely recognised, and Henkel is an experienced sports and events sponsor.

wiki.title: Henkel
wiki.text: Henkel AG & Co. KGaA, commonly known as Henkel, is a German multinational chemical and consumer goods company headquartered in Düsseldorf, Germany. Founded in 1876, the DAX company is organized into two globally operating business units and is known for brands such as Loctite, Persil, Fa, Pritt, Dial and Purex.

about: PTT Global Chemical (GC) is Thailand's largest integrated petrochemical company, based in Bangkok and majority-owned by state energy group PTT. It makes olefins, polyethylene, polypropylene, styrene, ethylene oxide derivatives and aromatics, and has bioplastics and recycling initiatives, with plants in Thailand, plus operations in the US, China and Europe. Customers are packaging, automotive and industrial manufacturers. Listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand (PTTGC), with revenue of several hundred billion baht. B2B industrial brand, though PTT is a known sponsor in Thailand.

wiki.title: PTT Global Chemical
wiki.text: PTT Global Chemical, also known as PTTGC, is a petrochemical company that specializes in synthesizing olefins and aromatics. It was founded in 2011 and is a subsidiary of PTT Public Company Limited.

about: British sustainable technologies company, headquartered in London, with roots in precious metals refining from 1817, that makes catalysts, emission control systems for vehicles, battery and hydrogen materials, and platinum group metal services. Customers are carmakers, chemical companies and industrial firms globally, with revenue of several billion pounds. Listed on the London Stock Exchange (JMAT) and agreed in 2025 to sell its Catalyst Technologies unit to Honeywell. Well-known industrial brand, B2B in nature.

wiki.title: Johnson Matthey
wiki.what: British multinational chemicals and sustainable technologies company
wiki.text: Johnson Matthey plc is a British multinational speciality chemicals and sustainable technologies company headquartered in London, England. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is a constituent of the FTSE 250 Index.

about: Entegris is a US supplier of advanced materials and process solutions for semiconductor manufacturing, including filters, chemical delivery systems, high-purity chemicals and gases, specialty coatings, and wafer and chip containers. Customers are the chipmakers and equipment makers, such as TSMC, Intel and Samsung, which buy products and replacements repeatedly. Revenue is several billion dollars, after the 2022 acquisition of CMC Materials. Listed on Nasdaq (ENTG) and headquartered in Billerica, Massachusetts, with a global footprint including Asia. B2B industrial brand with no consumer presence and low general public awareness.

wiki.title: Entegris
wiki.text: Entegris, Inc. is a supplier of materials for the semiconductor and other high-tech industries. Entegris has approximately 9,000 employees throughout its global operations. It has manufacturing, customer service and/or research facilities in the United States, Canada, China, Germany, Israel, Japan, Malaysia, Singapore, South Korea, and Taiwan. The company’s corporate headquarters are in Billerica, Massachusetts.

about: Indorama Ventures is a Thai-based global petrochemical company and the world's largest producer of PET resin for bottles, plus polyester fibres and yarns and ethylene oxide derivatives, with plants across Asia, Europe, the Americas and Africa. Customers include beverage and packaging companies like Coca-Cola and PepsiCo, plus textile and tyre-cord makers. It is a subsidiary of the Lohia family-led Indorama group and is listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand (IVL). Revenue is above 15 billion dollars. B2B supplier with limited consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Indorama Ventures
wiki.text: Indorama Ventures (IVL) is a producer of intermediate petrochemicals industry, the world's largest producer of PET resins.

about: Agricultural and construction equipment maker incorporated in the UK and run from Basildon, owning New Holland, Case IH, Case Construction and Steyr, and spun off from the former Fiat Industrial group. Revenue is about $20 billion. Listed on the NYSE and Milan (CNH). Strong brand among farmers and builders, but low consumer awareness. CNH employs about 40,000 people, operates factories in North America, Europe and Brazil, and sells through a global dealer network.

wiki.title: CNH Industrial
wiki.text: CNH Industrial NV is an American-British multinational corporation with global headquarters in Basildon, United Kingdom, but controlled and mostly owned by the Dutch investment company Exor, which in turn is controlled by the Agnelli family. Through its various businesses, CNH Industrial designs, produces, and sells agricultural machinery and construction equipment. Present in all major markets worldwide, CNH Industrial is focused on expanding its presence in high-growth markets, including through joint ventures. In 2019 CNH Industrial employed more than 63,000 people in 67 manufacturing plants and 56 research and development centers. The com

about: Chicago-based salt producer, founded 1848, known for its Morton Salt 'umbrella girl' logo, selling table, water-softening, de-icing and industrial salt in North America. Owned by Stone Canyon Industries after its 2023 purchase from K+S. Strong US consumer brand recognition. Products also include water softener salt, with strong supermarket distribution. Morton is distributed in grocery stores across the US, Canada and Mexico, and the company has plants in Illinois, Texas and Louisiana.

wiki.title: Morton Salt
wiki.text: Morton Salt is an American food company producing salt for food, water conditioning, industrial, agricultural, and road/highway use. Based in Kansas City, the business is North America's leading producer and marketer of salt. It is a subsidiary of holding company Stone Canyon Industries Holdings, Inc.

about: Hamburg-based German wind turbine manufacturer, founded 1985, supplying onshore turbines worldwide, with Acciona holding about 40 percent after absorbing Acciona Energia's wind unit in 2016. Listed in Frankfurt (NDX1). B2B brand with no consumer visibility. Operates factories in Germany, Spain and elsewhere with thousands of turbines installed, and revenue of about EUR 7 billion. Nordex has about 10,000 employees and has installed over 50 gigawatts of turbines, including offshore-capable variants.

wiki.title: Nordex
wiki.text: Nordex SE is a European company that designs, sells and manufactures wind turbines, founded in 1985 and headquartered in the German city of Hamburg with production in Germany, Brazil, India, Mexico, Poland and Spain. According to the company, it had installed wind turbines with a total capacity of around 50 GW in over 40 countries worldwide by the end of 2023.

about: ADNOC is the Abu Dhabi National Oil Company, the state-owned energy group of the United Arab Emirates, headquartered in Abu Dhabi. It produces about 4 million barrels of oil a day, operates gas, refining, petrochemicals and shipping through subsidiaries such as ADNOC Distribution, ADNOC Gas and Borouge, and invests in renewables via Masdar. Customers are global energy buyers and retail fuel customers in the UAE. Its sponsorship profile is established, including in Formula 1 and other sport, and consumer visibility is strong in the Gulf.

wiki.title: Abu Dhabi National Oil Company
wiki.text: The Abu Dhabi National Oil Company, known by its acronym ADNOC, is the state-owned oil company of Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. It is the world's 12th largest oil company by production. In 2024, ADNOC had a crude oil production capacity of 4.85 million barrels per day and planned to increase it to 5 million barrels per day by 2027. It is the United Arab Emirate's largest oil company.

about: Ball Corporation is a Colorado-based packaging company, founded in 1880 and listed on the New York Stock Exchange (BALL), and one of the largest makers of aluminium beverage cans in the world. It supplies drinks brands such as Coca-Cola, PepsiCo and brewers, and also reusable aluminium cups and bottles, with revenue of about $12 billion. It sold its aerospace unit to BAE Systems in 2024. B2B packaging supplier with limited consumer awareness, although it is a known supplier to major drinks brands.

wiki.title: Ball Corporation
wiki.what: American aerospace and metal food and beverage container manufacturer
wiki.text: Ball Corporation is an American aluminum manufacturing company headquartered in Westminster, Colorado, United States. It is best known for its early production of glass jars, lids, and related products used for home canning. Since its founding in Buffalo, New York, in 1880, when it was known as the Wooden Jacket Can Company, the Ball company has expanded and diversified into other business ventures, including aerospace technology. It eventually became the world's largest manufacturer of recyclable aluminum packaging for a variety of beverage, home and personal care applications.

about: Crown Holdings is a Pennsylvania-based metal packaging company, listed on the New York Stock Exchange (CCK), which makes aluminium and steel beverage cans, food cans, aerosol containers and closures for brands such as Coca-Cola, PepsiCo and major food companies. It has about 130 plants worldwide and annual sales of about $12 billion. Customers are consumer goods and food companies. B2B packaging supplier with little direct consumer brand awareness.

wiki.title: Crown Holdings
wiki.text: Crown Holdings, Inc. is an American multinational packaging company headquartered in Tampa, Florida, that designs and manufactures rigid-metal packaging including aluminum beverage cans, metal food cans, aerosol cans, and specialty packaging. Founded in 1892, as the Crown Cork & Seal Company, the company is ranked No. 356 in the Fortune 500 list for 2026. As of 2026, Crown employs over 23,000 people at 189 plants in 39 countries.

about: French testing, inspection and certification group, founded in 1828, with about 80,000 staff in 140 countries, auditing buildings, industrial plants, marine assets and consumer goods. Based in Courbevoie and listed on Euronext Paris (BVI). Revenue about EUR 6.5 billion. B2B with strong industry recognition and little consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Bureau Veritas
wiki.text: Bureau Veritas S.A. is a French company specialized in testing, inspection and certification founded in 1828. It operates in a variety of sectors, including building and infrastructure, agri-food and commodities, marine and offshore, industry, certification, consumer products, and education.

about: Kawasaki Heavy Industries is a Japanese industrial conglomerate based in Kobe and Tokyo, making motorcycles (Kawasaki Ninja, Z series), jet skis, rolling stock, aerospace components, ships, gas turbines, robots and hydrogen equipment. It sells to consumers, railway operators, defence ministries and industry, with revenue near 2 trillion yen and tens of thousands of employees. Founded in 1896 and listed in Tokyo (7012). The Kawasaki motorcycle brand is very visible globally and has a heavy motorsport presence.

wiki.title: Kawasaki Heavy Industries
wiki.text: Kawasaki Heavy Industries Ltd. (KHI) is a Japanese public multinational corporation manufacturer of motorcycles, engines, heavy equipment, aerospace and defense equipment, rolling stock and ships, headquartered in Minato, Tokyo, Japan. It is also active in the production of industrial robots, gas turbines, pumps, boilers and other industrial products. The company is named after its founder, Shōzō Kawasaki. KHI is known as one of the three major heavy industrial manufacturers of Japan, alongside Mitsubishi Heavy Industries and IHI. Prior to the Second World War, KHI was part of the Kobe Kawasaki zaibatsu, which included Kawasaki Steel and Kawa

about: International Flavors & Fragrances (IFF) is a US-headquartered maker of flavours, fragrances, food ingredients, health and biosciences ingredients and pharma solutions. It sells to makers of food and drinks, perfumes, household and personal care products, and has plants and labs worldwide. Based in New York, it was formed by IFF's 2021 merger with DuPont's nutrition and biosciences unit. Listed on the NYSE (IFF) with revenue near 11 billion dollars. B2B ingredient supplier with low consumer awareness.

wiki.title: International Flavors & Fragrances
wiki.text: International Flavors & Fragrances Inc. (IFF) is an American corporation that creates products across taste, texture, scent, nutrition, enzymes, cultures, soy proteins, and probiotics categories, which it markets globally. It is headquartered in New York City and has creative, sales, and manufacturing facilities in 44 countries. The company is a member of the S&P 500 index.

about: Avery Dennison is a materials science company making pressure-sensitive labels and packaging materials, RFID and digital identification solutions (used widely in apparel tracking), and graphics and reflective products. Customers are consumer goods, apparel, retail, logistics and healthcare firms. Founded in 1935 and headquartered in Mentor, Ohio (moving to Glendale, California), with about 35,000 employees in over 50 countries and revenue near 9 billion dollars. Listed on the NYSE (AVY). The Avery office-product brand was sold to CCL in 2014. B2B with strong industry presence, little consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Avery Dennison
wiki.text: Avery Dennison Corporation is an American multinational manufacturer and distributor of pressure-sensitive adhesive materials, apparel branding labels and tags, RFID inlays, and specialty medical products. The company is a member of the Fortune 500 and is headquartered in Mentor, Ohio.

about: Polaris Inc. is a manufacturer of off-road vehicles, snowmobiles, motorcycles and boats, with brands including Polaris RZR and Ranger, Indian Motorcycle, Slingshot, Ski-Doo competitors, Pontoon boats and Aixam. It sells through dealers worldwide to consumers and commercial customers, with revenue of about 7 billion dollars and 15,000 employees. Founded in 1954 in Roseau, Minnesota, and headquartered in Medina (Long Lake area), Minnesota. Listed on the NYSE (PII). Strong enthusiast consumer brand with extensive racing and event sponsorship experience.

wiki.title: Polaris
wiki.what: Northern pole-star; brightest star in Ursa Minor
wiki.text: Polaris is a yellow supergiant star in the northern circumpolar constellation of Ursa Minor. It is designated α Ursae Minoris and is commonly called the North Star. With an apparent magnitude that fluctuates around 1.98, it is the brightest star in the constellation and is readily visible to the naked eye at night. The position of the star lies less than 1° away from the north celestial pole, making it the current northern pole star. The stable position of the star in the Northern Sky makes it useful for navigation.

wiki.title: Polaris Inc.
wiki.text: Polaris Inc. is an American automotive manufacturer headquartered in Medina, Minnesota, United States. Polaris was founded in Roseau, Minnesota, where it still has engineering and manufacturing facilities. The company manufactured motorcycles through its Victory Motorcycles subsidiary until January 2017, then produced motorcycles through the Indian Motorcycle subsidiary, which it purchased in April 2011 and announced its divestiture in October 2025. Polaris produced personal watercraft from 1994 to 2004. The company was originally named Polaris Industries Inc. and was renamed in 2019 to Polaris Inc.

about: Veralto is a Waltham, Massachusetts water analytics, treatment and product-identification company spun off from Danaher in 2023, whose brands include Hach, Trojan Technologies, Videojet, Esko and X-Rite. Customers are utilities, industrial plants and consumer packaged goods makers, with revenue of roughly $5 billion. Listed on the NYSE under VLTO. B2B industrial technology group with limited consumer brand awareness.

wiki.title: Veralto
wiki.text: Veralto Corporation is an American technology company headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts. It produces products related to water analytics, water treatment, marking and coding, and packaging and color.

about: Unitree Robotics is a Hangzhou-based Chinese robotics company, making quadruped robot dogs (Go2, B2) and humanoid robots (H1, G1) for research, entertainment and industrial uses, with a strong rise in profile in 2025. The input location is garbled. It has been preparing a STAR Market IPO. Known in tech circles and online for viral robot videos.

wiki.title: Unitree Robotics
wiki.text: Hangzhou Yushu Technology Co., Ltd., doing business as Unitree Robotics, is a robotics company based in Hangzhou, China. Founded by Wang Xingxing in August 2016, Unitree initially specialized in quadruped robots for the consumer market. In 2024, the company began producing humanoid robots, with the second iteration priced around US$16,000.

about: Axalta Coating Systems is a global coatings maker headquartered in Philadelphia, producing liquid and powder coatings for car refinish (Cromax, Standox, Spies Hecker brands), light vehicles, commercial vehicles and industrial applications. It was carved out of DuPont's performance coatings business in 2013, after Carlyle bought it. Customers are body shops, car makers and industrial manufacturers, and it has revenue of around $5 billion with roughly 12,000 employees and sales in about 130 countries. It is listed on the NYSE (AXTA). B2B brand with a long record in motorsport sponsorship, including NASCAR.

wiki.title: Axalta
wiki.text: Axalta Coating Systems Ltd., also known as simply Axalta, is an American company specializing in coatings in a wide variety of industrial applications, materials and sectors, including automotive paints. The company is based in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, and incorporated in Bermuda. Axalta develops and manufactures coatings for light and commercial vehicles, industrial, and refinish applications. The firm does business in 130 countries, has nearly 13,000 employees, and has more than 100,000 customers.

about: Pandora is a Danish jewellery maker and retailer based in Copenhagen, best known for its charm bracelets and rings, and increasingly lab-grown diamond jewellery. It designs and manufactures in Thailand and sells through thousands of points of sale, including around 2,700 concept stores, in about 100 countries, with revenue of roughly DKK 28-30 billion. Customers are mainly women buying gifts and self-purchases. Listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen (PNDORA), founded in 1982. Very recognisable consumer brand with global reach and heavy marketing spend.

wiki.title: Pandora
wiki.text: In Greek mythology, Pandora was the first human woman, created by Hephaestus on the instructions of Zeus. As Hesiod related it, each deity cooperated by giving her unique gifts. Her other name—inscribed against her figure on a white-ground kylix in the British Museum—is Anesidora.

about: Hitachi is a Tokyo-based Japanese industrial and technology conglomerate, operating digital systems and services (including GlobalLogic and Hitachi Vantara), energy (Hitachi Energy), mobility (rail, including Hitachi Rail), building systems and elevators, automation, and construction equipment interests. Customers are governments, utilities, infrastructure operators and businesses. Founded in 1910, it is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (6501), with revenue of roughly JPY 9-10 trillion and about 270,000 employees. Well-known global corporate brand.

wiki.title: Hitachi
wiki.what: Japanese multinational engineering and electronics company
wiki.text: Hitachi, Ltd. is a Japanese multinational conglomerate founded in 1910 and headquartered in Chiyoda, Tokyo. The company is active in various industries, including digital systems, power and renewable energy, railway systems, healthcare products, and financial systems. The company was founded as an electrical machinery manufacturing subsidiary of the Kuhara Mining Plant in Hitachi, Ibaraki, by engineer Namihei Odaira in 1910. It began operating as an independent company under its current name in 1920.

about: JK Tyre and Industries is an Indian tyre manufacturer based in New Delhi, part of the JK Organisation. It makes truck, bus, passenger car, farm and two-wheeler tyres and sells them in India and export markets through a large dealer network. It operates plants in India and Mexico and other countries after acquiring Cavendish Industries and Cooper Tire's Indian assets. Listed on NSE and BSE, it is a recognised consumer-facing brand in India and has sponsored motorsport, including rallying and karting.

Finnish industrial technology group supplying equipment, process technology and services to mining, aggregates, metals refining and recycling customers, including crushers, grinding mills, flotation cells, filters, smelting technology and spare parts. Formed in 2020 by merging Metso Minerals with Outotec, and later shortened to Metso. Sales are close to 5 billion euros with around 16,000 staff in about 50 countries. Listed on Nasdaq Helsinki. B2B engineering brand, well known to industrial buyers but not to consumers.

wiki.title: Metso
wiki.text: Metso Corporation was a Finnish industrial machinery company focusing on providing technology and services for mining, and aggregates industries.

wiki.title: Metso (2020–present)
wiki.text: Metso Corporation is a Finnish publicly traded company established in 2020 when Outotec and Metso Minerals merged. It is focusing on providing technology and services for mining, aggregates, recycling, and metal refining industries. The company is headquartered in Matinkylä, Espoo, in Finland.

about: Bahri, the National Shipping Company of Saudi Arabia, operates one of the world's largest fleets of very large crude carriers (VLCCs), plus chemical tankers, bulk carriers and roll-on roll-off vessels, and offers logistics services. Headquartered in Riyadh, with the Public Investment Fund the largest shareholder. Customers are oil producers, refiners and chemical shippers, including Saudi Aramco. Listed on Tadawul (4030). Well-known corporate brand in Saudi Arabia and B2B shipping circles.

wiki.title: Bahri
wiki.text: Bahri is a masculine Arabic given name.

wiki.title: Bahri (company)
wiki.what: National shipping carrier of Saudi Arabia
wiki.text: Bahri, formerly known as the National Shipping Company of Saudi Arabia, is a transportation and logistics company, positioned as the national shipping carrier of Saudi Arabia.

about: HD Korea Shipbuilding & Offshore Engineering is the shipbuilding holding company of HD Hyundai, headquartered in Seongnam (operations in Ulsan), one of the world's biggest shipbuilders of LNG carriers, container ships, tankers and naval vessels. It is a subsidiary of HD Hyundai and listed on the Korea Exchange (009540). Customers are shipping companies and navies. B2B, with HD Hyundai a visible sports sponsor in Korea.

Networking hardware, software and services company, supplying optical and packet networking gear used by telecom carriers, cloud providers, governments and enterprises to move data over fiber, including coherent optics (WaveLogic) and Blue Planet software. Revenue near 4 billion dollars. Headquartered in Hanover, Maryland; founded 1992. Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (CIEN). B2B brand with low public visibility, but well known in telecom circles.

wiki.title: Ciena
wiki.text: Ciena Corporation is an American optical networking systems and software company based in Hanover, Maryland. The company reported revenues of $4.8 billion and more than 9,000 employees, as of November 2025. Gary Smith has been president and chief executive officer (CEO) since 2003.

about: US-based global courier and logistics company running FedEx Express, Ground and Freight services, along with supply chain, e-commerce and customs solutions, delivering packages to over 220 countries with revenue near 88 billion dollars and 500,000 employees. Customers are consumers, shippers and enterprises. Headquartered in Memphis, Tennessee; founded 1971 by Fred Smith. Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (FDX), with a freight spin-off planned for 2026. Very strong B2B and consumer brand, with extensive sponsorship history including NASCAR, NFL and Formula 1.

wiki.title: FedEx
wiki.text: FedEx Corporation is an American multinational transportation, e-commerce, and business-services company headquartered in Memphis, Tennessee. Founded in 1971 by Frederick W. Smith as Federal Express Corporation, it began operations in 1973 as an express delivery company centered on an air-and-ground network based at Memphis International Airport. FedEx now provides parcel delivery, express transportation, freight forwarding, logistics, customs brokerage, supply-chain services, and retail printing and shipping services worldwide. In fiscal 2026, the company reported revenue of $94.7 billion and employed about 452,000 people.

about: Gopuff is a US instant delivery service for snacks, groceries, alcohol, personal care and household items from micro-fulfilment centres, with 15-minute-style delivery in many cities and a retail presence through BevMo, which it owns. Customers are consumers using the Gopuff app, and it has operated in the US and the UK and Ireland. Headquartered in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania; founded 2013. Privately held with SoftBank and others as investors, valued at about 15 billion dollars in 2021. Known to US urban consumers, with a history of sports sponsorship.

wiki.title: Gopuff
wiki.text: GoBrands, Inc., doing business as Gopuff, is an American consumer goods and food delivery company headquartered in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. The company delivers foods and goods typically found in convenience stores in more than 500 cities, suburbs, and towns across the United States as of 2025. It also operates in the United Kingdom, following an acquisition of Newcastle upon Tyne-based Fancy.

about: Prologis is the world's largest industrial real estate investment trust, based in San Francisco, owning and leasing roughly 1.3 billion square feet of logistics warehouses in 20 countries to retailers, e-commerce, third-party logistics and manufacturing firms such as Amazon. Revenue is around $8bn. It also builds data centers and energy projects. Listed on the NYSE (PLD). B2B landlord with low consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Prologis
wiki.text: Prologis, Inc. is a real estate investment trust headquartered in San Francisco, California that invests in logistics facilities. The company was formed through the merger of AMB Property Corporation and Prologis in June 2011, which made Prologis the largest industrial real estate company in the world. As of 2025, the company operates more than 15,000 land acres and over 6,000 buildings comprising about 1.3 billion square feet in 20 countries across North America, Latin America, Europe, and Asia. According to The Economist, its business strategy is focused on warehouses that are located close to huge urban areas where land is scarce. It serve

about: J&T Express is an Indonesian-born express delivery company, headquartered in Jakarta, operating a franchised parcel network across Southeast Asia, China, Brazil, Mexico, the Middle East and Africa, handling billions of parcels a year for e-commerce sellers and consumers. It listed in Hong Kong (1519) in 2023. Backed by Sequoia, Hillhouse, Boyu, Tencent and Alibaba-linked investors. A familiar e-commerce logistics brand across Southeast Asia, with football and other sponsorships.

wiki.title: J&T Express
wiki.text: J&T Express is an international delivery company founded in August 2015 in Jakarta, Indonesia. Its core business is express services and cross-border logistics.

about: HelloFresh is a Berlin-based meal-kit company founded in 2011, delivering boxes of recipes and pre-portioned ingredients to subscribers in the US, Europe, Canada, Australia and Japan under HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, Factor and YouFoodz. Revenue is about 7.5 billion euros with millions of active customers. Listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange (HFG). High consumer brand awareness, heavy advertiser, and has sponsored sports including football in Germany.
flags: name read with low OCR confidence: check spelling

wiki.title: HelloFresh
wiki.text: HelloFresh SE is a German multinational meal-kit company based in Berlin. Founded in 2011, it is one of the largest meal-kit providers in the world, operating in Australia, Canada, New Zealand, the United States, and Western Europe. Aside from its flagship brand, the company also owns and operates subsidiary brands such as Green Chef, EveryPlate and Factor.

about: Heidelberg Materials, until 2023 named HeidelbergCement, is a German building materials group, based in Heidelberg, and one of the world's largest producers of cement, aggregates and ready-mixed concrete, with operations in about 50 countries and annual revenue of around 20 billion euros. It also works on carbon capture and low-carbon cement. Customers are construction and infrastructure firms. Listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange, in the DAX, as HEI. A B2B heavy-industry brand with low consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Heidelberg Materials
wiki.text: Heidelberg Materials is a German multinational building materials company headquartered in Heidelberg, Germany. Formerly known as HeidelbergCement AG, the company has rebranded as Heidelberg Materials in September 2022. It is a DAX corporation and stands as one of the world's largest building materials companies. On 1 July 2016, HeidelbergCement AG completed the acquisition of a 45% shareholding in Italcementi. This acquisition made HeidelbergCement the number one producer of construction aggregates, the second-largest in cement and the third-largest in ready-mixed concrete worldwide. In the 2020 Forbes Global 2000, HeidelbergCement was ranke

about: Saint-Gobain is a French building materials multinational that makes glass, insulation, plasterboard (Placo, Gyproc), ceramics, mortars, pipes and construction chemicals, and distributes materials through merchants like Point.P, Dahl and Cedeo. Its brands include Isover, Weber, Gyproc, Placo and Ecophon. Customers are builders, construction firms, contractors, car makers and industries, in about 75 countries, with revenue near 46 billion euros and over 160,000 staff. Founded in 1665 and listed on Euronext Paris (SGO). Strong B2B brand with some consumer awareness through DIY channels, and a long record of sports and cultural sponsorship.
flags: last funding 2009: check it is still independent and operating

wiki.title: Saint-Gobain
wiki.what: French glass and construction material manufacturer
wiki.text: Compagnie de Saint-Gobain S.A. is a French multinational corporation, founded in 1665 in Paris as the Manufacture royale de glaces de miroirs, and today headquartered on the outskirts of Paris, at La Défense and in Courbevoie. Originally a mirror manufacturer, it also produces a variety of construction, high-performance, moderate-performance, lower-performance and other materials. Saint-Gobain is present in 76 countries and as of 2022 employs more than 170,000 people.

about: Ferretti Group is an Italian luxury yacht builder and one of the largest makers of motor yachts in the world. Its brands include Ferretti Yachts, Riva, Pershing, Itama, Wally, CRN and Custom Line, and it builds boats in yards across Italy, with annual revenue of well over 1 billion euros. Customers are high-net-worth individuals and charter companies, and revenue comes from boat sales, services and refits. The Chinese state-owned Weichai Group bought control in 2012, and the company listed on the Hong Kong exchange and later on Euronext Milan in 2022. Strong luxury marine brands with a wealthy buyer base, a good match for F1 hospitality audiences.

wiki.title: Ferretti Group
wiki.text: Ferretti S.p.A. is a multinational shipbuilding company headquartered in Forlì which specialises in the design, construction and sale of luxury motor yachts. Its products are sold under the brands Wally, Ferretti Yachts, Custom Line, Pershing, Itama, Riva, Mochi Craft and CRN.

about: Australia's largest steel company, making coated and painted steel such as ZINCALUME and COLORBOND for roofing and cladding, plus structural steel, with major operations in Australia, North America (North Star BlueScope and Butler buildings), New Zealand and Asia. Annual revenue is around 17 billion Australian dollars with about 14,000 staff. Listed on the ASX (BSL). COLORBOND is a very familiar building brand to Australian homeowners.

wiki.title: BlueScope
wiki.text: BlueScope Steel Limited is an Australian flat product steel producer that was spun-off from BHP Billiton in 2002.

about: Jacobs, now Jacobs Solutions, is a Dallas-based professional services group, listed on the NYSE (J), providing engineering, consulting, project management and technical services for infrastructure, water, transport, advanced facilities, defence, space and environmental clients, with around 60,000 employees worldwide. Customers are governments and large corporates. Revenue is about $11 billion a year in fees. B2B brand, widely known in engineering and project industries, with little consumer awareness.
